0022600155.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-5, 15th in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-4, 12th in the East) for their sixth game of the season, with Brooklyn on a five-game losing streak and sitting 4.5 games back in the Atlantic. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg, bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder, sprain), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle, sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), Obi Toppin (back, soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring, strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring, strain). The Nets trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 136-109 in Brooklyn on 2026-10-25, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
